correctness.rationale: Recomputed the Gram matrix from the actual value and derivative rows, including the rotation and Gaussian factor. Its parity traces and determinants agree. If the lower odd branch weighted by exp(-x) is stationary, then the displayed rational expression is forced (its numerator and denominator have no common positive zero). Exact independently generated Sturm sequences counted two positive sextic roots and one positive cubic root, one in each given interval. Rational branch signs put only the first candidate below half the odd trace; the positive lower-odd objective vanishes at both endpoints and hence has a unique interior maximizer. The common-eigenvalue polynomial identity and signed isolating intervals put the tie strictly below both half-traces, proving attainment of the odd ceiling and a two-dimensional minimum eigenspace. Independent higher-precision evaluation confirms the corrected decimal. The original checker's floating-point comparison does not certify trailing digits.
residual_risks: No claim for non-antipodal pairs or differently weighted channels; decimal evaluation is supplementary to the exact root description.
